Brands looking ahead to 2027 may want to take note of the latest industry trends, and examine how industry peers are planning to implement new tools like artificial intelligence to optimize their workflows.

The team from Emplifi recently surveyed 405 marketing managers, directors and executives to glean insights into the key trends they’re seeing in relation to AI use, product and brand discovery, and social media engagement trends.
The findings are summarized in the below overview, which could provide more guidance for next year’s strategic planning.
Ninety percent of respondents indicated that AI had increased their team’s output, while interestingly, 54% said that their social media team had increased in size, not reduced.
Fifty-five percent of respondents expect short-form video to continue to grow in relevance and influence.
Sixty-nine percent said that AI tools save them three or more hours per week on reporting.
These trend notes are worth considering.
